hashConvention.source: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source after CRLF/CR to LF normalization; no trimming.
hashConvention.declaration: Exact Tree-sitter declaration byte span, excluding preceding XML comments and trailing whitespace.
hashConvention.signature: Declaration start through block, arrow-expression or accessor-list start, with trailing whitespace removed.
hashConvention.body: Exact block, arrow-expression clause or accessor-list bytes.

scope: Two new proof/loader classes, two new bounded archive read methods, and all changed production forwarding/guard declarations. Complexity for existing large methods covers this increment only, not an audit of their unchanged bodies. No EGM statistical-basis adoption.

variables.Bn: Original NIF bytes, <=64 MiB for optional proof.
variables.Bt: Encoded TRI bytes, <=16 MiB under existing TriReader.
variables.N: Complete TRI V+K, <=500,000 under existing TriReader.
variables.S: Parsed shape owners examined during classification/extraction.
variables.P_N: Inherited NIF parse cost/storage, delegated; encoded-size limit is not a new decoded-structure memory guarantee.
variables.P_T: Inherited full TRI parse cost/storage, including morph data; not just topology parsing.
variables.C_N: Inherited full NIF block classification and its dictionaries/lists. Expected/amortized dictionary work differs from collision worst case.
variables.R_resolve: Existing ordered archive/loose resolver cost, including cache, rename mapping and optional fuzzy search; not replaced or claimed O(1).
variables.B: Selected extracted payload bytes, <= supplied maximum for the new bounded operation.

declarations.name: Find
declarations.timeBound: P_T(Bt) + P_N(Bn) + C_N + O(N) + up to A binding attempts as defined for TryBind; A <= 8.
declarations.spaceBound: Owned proof inputs belong to caller; delegated parsed documents/classification plus O(N) reference array and transient per-attempt binding storage.
declarations.review: Rejects NIF >64 MiB and big endian; TRI parsing is bounded by its existing 16 MiB profile and V+K <=500,000. Full displacement domain must match V+K. A second matching owner returns null. Reference positions are used only for existing topology binding, not adopted as an actor statistical domain.

declarations.name: FindCandidates
declarations.timeBound: C_N plus O(S) expected dictionary lookup/iteration and candidate checks. Pathological dictionary collisions can degrade lookup complexity.
declarations.spaceBound: Delegated classification dictionaries/lists plus at most 9 temporary candidate tuples (the ninth triggers refusal).
declarations.review: Classifies the parsed NIF before limiting visible matching-count legacy skinned owners to eight. The cap bounds binding repetitions, not initial classification or inherited parser work.

declarations.name: TryBind
declarations.timeBound: Delegates one bounded NIF parse/hash, local geometry extraction and oriented-facet comparison: P_N(Bn) + O(Bn + V + N + T log T + Tr log Tr), with geometry/dependency costs retained explicitly.
declarations.spaceBound: Delegated parsed NIF/geometry storage plus O(V + N + T + Tr) temporary vertices, references, maps and facet keys; no fixed total-byte ceiling is inferred from encoded limits.
declarations.review: Calls existing TriNifBinding.Bind. InvalidDataException/NotSupportedException produce no proof. Oriented topology uses sorted cyclic facet keys, preserves multiplicity and drops repeated-index degenerates; it is not a coordinate-equality or coefficient-basis proof.

declarations.name: ValidateSource
declarations.timeBound: O(Bn) SHA-256 on admitted source, or O(1) early refusal.
declarations.review: Checks <=64 MiB, exact checked FullVertexCount*3 delta length and original NIF hash before extraction. Assumes the caller-supplied parsed NifInfo corresponds to those bytes.

declarations.name: Matches
declarations.review: Requires both exact shape owner and geometry-data block indices.

declarations.name: Load
declarations.timeBound: R_resolve for at most two selected paths + bounded source read/decompression + Find proof cost.
declarations.spaceBound: At most 64 MiB NIF and 16 MiB TRI payload arrays plus delegated proof allocations and source-locator/log strings.
declarations.review: Uses only explicit selected NIF/TRI through existing ordered resolver. Missing/unsupported/ambiguous proof returns null and retains the old route; expected read/profile errors are logged. No cache, long-lived handle or new cancellation is added.

declarations.name: TryExtractFileBounded
declarations.timeBound: O(request path length) normalization + R_resolve + bounded read/decompression.
declarations.spaceBound: Normalized path plus bounded returned byte array and inherited extraction workspace.
declarations.review: Rejects negative maximum; preserves existing resolver/cache, donor order, rename/fuzzy/loose policy and actual backing/resolved-path provenance. Resolver average/amortized dictionary behavior is not a worst-case constant-time guarantee.

declarations.name: ReadSourceBounded
declarations.timeBound: O(B) loose read; delegated BSA/BA2 read and decompression for admitted stored/decoded lengths.
declarations.spaceBound: O(B) returned array plus existing archive decompressor workspace, with B <= supplied maximum.
declarations.review: BSA uses existing bounded extraction; BA2 requires General and RealSize/PackedSize <= maximum before extraction. Loose length check precedes allocation, exact read plus an EOF probe detects growth. The stream is disposed. Final decoded length is rechecked; wall-clock I/O is not bounded.

declarations.name: Extract
declarations.timeBound: Increment: O(Bn) source validation when target supplied, plus O(1) owner/data comparison per encountered shape (O(S)).
declarations.spaceBound: Increment: fixed hash/target references; existing extraction allocations unchanged.
declarations.review: Validates before geometry extraction; only the matching skinned owner consumes deltas, before skinning. Null target preserves first-skinned behavior; filtering the target cannot redirect its deltas. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

declarations.name: Extract
declarations.timeBound: Increment: O(Bn) validation when target supplied, plus delegated changed ExtractMeshParts cost.
declarations.review: Checks source/full domain before extraction and forwards the optional target. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

declarations.name: ExtractMeshParts
declarations.timeBound: Increment: O(1) exact target comparison per encountered shape (O(S)).
declarations.review: Consumes the displacement array only after the matching skinned owner, preserving local export placement and null-target behavior. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

declarations.name: HeadPreSkinMorphTarget
declarations.review: Adds a Core-owned optional proof; no source blob/parsed document ownership.

declarations.name: BuildHeadPlan
declarations.timeBound: Increment: optional Load proof cost, plus O(1) plan reference assignment.
declarations.spaceBound: Increment: delegated temporary proof allocations plus fixed retained target.
declarations.review: Uses explicit BaseHeadNifPath/BaseHeadTriPath and the unchanged legacy full displacement array. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

declarations.name: LoadExtractedNif
declarations.timeBound: Increment: O(1) forwarding plus delegated extractor validation.
declarations.review: Appends the optional parameter and forwards it; unrelated callers retain null. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

declarations.name: AddHeadContent
declarations.timeBound: Increment: O(1) forwarding plus delegated extractor validation.
declarations.review: Forwards the head-plan proof for the base-head load. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

declarations.name: AddHeadContent
declarations.timeBound: Increment: optional Load proof cost plus forwarding/validation.
declarations.spaceBound: Increment: delegated proof allocations plus fixed proof reference.
declarations.review: Legacy overload obtains optional proof from explicit paths and unchanged legacy deltas; no new coefficient computation. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

declarations.name: BuildFromPlan
declarations.timeBound: Increment: O(1) proof forwarding plus delegated extractor validation.
declarations.review: Both head-loading branches carry the plan proof. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

declarations.name: ApplyHeadRenderOverrides
declarations.timeBound: Increment: O(1)
declarations.spaceBound: Increment: O(1) retained reference in the existing replacement plan.
declarations.review: Preserves HeadPreSkinMorphTarget when copying render overrides. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

declarations.name: LoadHeadWithPreSkinMorphs
declarations.timeBound: Increment: O(1) forwarding plus delegated extractor validation.
declarations.review: Forwards the proof to native geometry extraction without changing texture or coefficient policy. Only the changed forwarding/guard behavior is reviewed; unchanged method internals are outside this delta review.

resourceBounds.selectedInputs: Optional proof reads at most 64 MiB NIF +16 MiB TRI. Existing archive indexes, EGM parsing and no-proof legacy extraction are not newly bounded.
resourceBounds.repetition: At most eight binding attempts after initial classification; each can parse/hash NIF and sort oriented-facet keys. No retained proof cache is added.
resourceBounds.ownership: Target retains fixed identity/count/topology fields only. Source payload, parsed documents, V+K reference and per-candidate binding arrays are temporary. Caller original NIF/TRI/deltas are not changed.
resourceBounds.inheritedCosts: NIF/TRI parser and decompressor work remain delegated. Input byte ceilings are not a measured process-peak or wall-clock bound. Synchronous composition adds no cancellation.

policy.proof: Exact source owner/data plus indexed oriented topology and complete V+K length. Distinct matching owners decline the optional proof.
policy.fallback: Missing, unsupported or ambiguous optional proof, and the loader's explicitly caught InvalidDataException/NotSupportedException/IOException/ArgumentException, preserve legacy first-skinned consumption. This is not universal corrected head identification or a guarantee to catch every unexpected failure.
policy.basis: Actor coefficient basis, EGM-to-TRI pairing and actor neutral/coordinate-domain evidence remain unverified. Raw TRI V+K reference is not adopted as an actor statistical domain.
policy.legacyArithmetic: EgmParser and FaceGenMeshMorpher unchanged: coefficient-family truncation, accumulation order, 1e-7 epsilon, near-zero-result policy and full V+K storage; visible geometry consumes V.
policy.parsedObjectTrust: ValidateSource checks original bytes and delta length, not an independently supplied/mutated NifInfo graph.
